name: Roast Pepper-Pork Patties with Carrot, Cucumber, Almond & Dill Salad

instructions.primary_message: Drain and roughly chop roasted peppers. Divide between two large bowls. (Set one bowl aside for the salad.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (340 g) jars roasted red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Add pork, bread crumbs, eggs, salt, and pepper to the first bowl with the peppers. Use your hands to combine the pork mixture. Using a ¼-cup measure, form the mixture into ½-inch thick patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground pork
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 eggs
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add patties and cook, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the second bowl with the peppers.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Add carrots, almonds, and vinaigrette to the bowl, then stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots
⅓ cup almonds, sliced
⅓ cup French vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide patties and salad between plates. Enjoy!
